cases.name: Tatianna Marie "Tayah" Ehnes-Giles
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Tayah was a well-loved waitress for eight years at the Lakeville Buckboard. You could always find Tayah doing something with her family. She especially loved the 4th of July event she hosted every year. Tayah loved the fall and spending time outside having bonfires. We are convinced Tayah's favorite thing to do was argue with her mother about where she got her attitude from, or her siblings about how she was the favorite child. Tayah was always there if you needed her, Tayah might not have always told you what you wanted to hear, but she would always be there. Tayah was a loving mother, daughter, sister, aunt, niece and friend. Tayah lived for her children Myles and as Tayah called her, her Banana."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot and killed her at her home on her birthday.
